description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for 'Pocket' related endpoints in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for linking/delinking accounts and retrieving linked accounts details.

classes.name: PocketApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container for Swagger documentation classes related to Pocket API endpoints.

classes.name: PostLinkDelinkAccountsToFromPocketRequest
classes.description: Request schema for linking or delinking accounts to/from Pocket.

classes.name: GetPocketAccountDetail
classes.description: Details about a specific Pocket account, including account ID and type.

classes.name: PostLinkDelinkAccountsToFromPocketResponse
classes.description: Response schema for linking/delinking accounts, primarily including resource ID.

classes.name: GetAccountsLinkedToPocketResponse
classes.description: Response schema listing accounts linked to a Pocket, including loans, savings, and shares.

classes.name: GetPocketLoanAccounts
classes.description: Details of a loan account linked to a Pocket.

classes.name: GetPocketSavingAccounts
classes.description: Details of a saving account linked to a Pocket.

classes.name: GetPocketShareAccounts
classes.description: Details of a share account linked to a Pocket (empty placeholder).
